exposure: Monochorionic pregnancies with abnormal growth not meeting sFGR criteria
2019 expert consensus-based diagnostic parameters for selective fetal growth restriction
International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology (ISUOG) definition (2015)
2015 ISUOG definition of selective fetal growth restriction
sFGR diagnosis based on 2015 ISUOG definition vs. 2019 expert consensus parameters
finding: While the 2019 expert consensus parameters increased the number of sFGR cases by over 50%, this reclassification did not lead to significant differences in neonatal outcomes compared to the 2015 ISUOG definition.
